description: Read-only. Which of the 7 publishable platforms (youtube, tiktok, linkedin, instagram, bluesky, mastodon, threads) the user has connected in the Katto dashboard: { connections: [{ platform, connected, display_name, reconnect_required, connected_at }], connect_url }. Call it BEFORE katto_publish_clip to pick a platform that will work: if the one the user wants shows connected=false or reconnect_required=true, ask them to (re)connect it at connect_url instead of attempting the publish. Never returns tokens.
name: katto_list_connected_accounts
